claim_verbatim: By 2028, AI and data infrastructure are on track to add about 0.5 to 0.6 Mt of annual copper demand above 2024 levels.
source: Essay: COPPER: LIMITS TO GROWTH IN THE AGE OF DEMAND SIMULTANEITY
resolution_criterion: YES if credible sector estimates show AI/data-center copper demand in 2028 is 0.45–0.70 Mt above 2024; NO if outside that band.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if credible sector estimates show AI/data-center copper demand in 2028 is 0.45–0.70 Mt above 2024; NO if outside that band.

claim_verbatim: The cumulative deployment of NVIDIA-based AI systems over these four years will require about 268,450 tonnes of copper.
source: Essay: COPPER: LIMITS TO GROWTH IN THE AGE OF DEMAND SIMULTANEITY
resolution_criterion: YES if bottom-up tallies of NVIDIA-class AI hardware copper over 2026–2029 land within ±25% of 268,450 t; NO if outside or deployment much smaller.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if bottom-up tallies of NVIDIA-class AI hardware copper over 2026–2029 land within ±25% of 268,450 t; NO if outside or deployment much smaller.

claim_verbatim: Rubin Ultra due in 2027 and Feynman in 2028, one new generation every year.
context: NVIDIA roadmap as stated in Metabolism essay.
source: Essay: The Metabolism of Artificial Intelligence
resolution_criterion: YES if NVIDIA ships Rubin Ultra-class in calendar 2027 and Feynman-class in calendar 2028; NO if either slips a full calendar year or is cancelled.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if NVIDIA ships Rubin Ultra-class in calendar 2027 and Feynman-class in calendar 2028; NO if either slips a full calendar year or is cancelled.

claim_verbatim: Grades started out in 1992 at 2.5-3% now they are FY25: 1.02% , FY26: 0.90% , FY27 about 0.70%.
context: Escondida copper grade path; FY27 is forward.
resolution_criterion: YES if BHP reports Escondida FY27 average copper grade within 0.60–0.80%; NO if outside.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if BHP reports Escondida FY27 average copper grade within 0.60–0.80%; NO if outside.
notes: Likely restating company guidance; confirm. Inferred 0.70 from about.

claim_verbatim: Australians are financially illiterate , stressed and about to cop an economic hiding .
resolution_criterion: YES if Australia experiences clear recession or sharp household stress (unemployment up >=1.5 pp from Jul 2026 or real per-capita consumption down) within 12 months; NO otherwise.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if Australia experiences clear recession or sharp household stress (unemployment up >=1.5 pp from Jul 2026 or real per-capita consumption down) within 12 months; NO otherwise.

claim_verbatim: In emerging markets, local food inflation could spike by 15–25% year-on-year
source: Essay: War, El Niño, Pestilence, and Famine
resolution_criterion: “Could” is not a forecast under ledger rules.
resolution_rule_fixed: “Could” is not a forecast under ledger rules.
